full: I cannot recommend Neven highly enough.

He didn’t just build what I asked for—he genuinely brought my vision to life. What started as an idea in my head has become something far better than I imagined. Throughout the project he suggested improvements and features I hadn’t even considered, while always keeping the project focused on what mattered most.

His communication has been exceptional from start to finish. Every question was answered quickly, everything was explained clearly, and despite me refining ideas as we went, he was always patient, professional and positive.

The quality of his work has exceeded every expectation. The portal is beautifully designed, intuitive, fast and exactly what my members needed. You can tell he genuinely cares about delivering an outstanding product, not just completing a contract.
Finding someone who combines technical skill with creativity, reliability and excellent communication is rare. Neven has all of those qualities.

I already know this won’t be our last project together. If you’re looking for a developer who treats your business like it’s his own and genuinely wants your project to succeed, don’t hesitate to hire him.
Thank you, Neven. You’ve helped turn one of my biggest business dreams into a reality.
fullHr: Nije samo napravio ono što sam tražila, nego je doista oživio moju viziju. Ono što je počelo kao ideja u mojoj glavi postalo je nešto puno bolje nego što sam zamišljala. Tijekom projekta predlagao je poboljšanja i funkcije na koje ja nisam ni pomislila, a pritom je projekt uvijek držao usredotočenim na ono što je najvažnije.

Njegova komunikacija bila je izvanredna od početka do kraja. Na svako pitanje odgovarao je brzo, sve je jasno objasnio i, iako sam usput dorađivala ideje, uvijek je bio strpljiv, profesionalan i pozitivan.

Kvaliteta njegova rada nadmašila je sva očekivanja. Portal je prekrasno dizajniran, intuitivan, brz i točno ono što su mojim članovima trebalo. Vidi se da mu je doista stalo do isporuke izvrsnog proizvoda, a ne samo do ispunjenja ugovora.
Teško je naći nekoga tko spaja tehničko znanje s kreativnošću, pouzdanošću i izvrsnom komunikacijom. Neven sve to ima.
Već znam da ovo neće biti naš posljednji zajednički projekt. Ako tražite developera koji se prema vašem poslu odnosi kao prema svom i iskreno želi da vaš projekt uspije, ne oklijevajte ga angažirati.
Hvala ti, Neven. Pomogao si da jedan od mojih najvećih poslovnih snova postane stvarnost.
